_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); cruise-line signals

pit_profile.why: Royal Caribbean: 'Together, our Global Brands and our Partner Brands operate a combined total of 61 ships in the cruise vacation industry with an aggregate capacity of approximately 141,570 berths as of December 31, 2019'; 'Our principal competitors are Carnival Corporation & plc'; 'We may lose business to competitors throughout the vacation market'; and 'The demand for cruises is affected by international, national and local economic conditions' (its own FY2019 10-K): a cruise-fleet franchise whose demand follows the economies it sells into, by its own account; no disruption theme is live for it

classification.quality_note: Royal Caribbean: 'Together, our Global Brands and our Partner Brands operate a combined total of 61 ships in the cruise vacation industry with an aggregate capacity of approximately 141,570 berths as of December 31, 2019'; 'Our principal competitors are Carnival Corporation & plc'; 'We may lose business to competitors throughout the vacation market'; and 'The demand for cruises is affected by international, national and local economic conditions' (its own FY2019 10-K): a cruise-fleet franchise whose demand follows the economies it sells into, by its own account; no disruption theme is live for it. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price cheap; Ratio B -0.08x; -55% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +0.60; conservative 2yr +186%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -27.1%/yr (worst year FY10-FY19, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +-16.3%/yr (Q1 revenues + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +16.7%/yr (FY10-FY19 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +40.7%/yr (best 2-yr run FY10-FY19); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: RCL (retrospective, 2020-05-21) ◉ BUY — Ratio B -0.08x (-29.2% downside to Bear $56 / +377.5% upside to Bull $207) | Adj composite 1.70 vs market 1.10: gap +0.60 [UNDERVALUED] | -55% above the EPP floor $95 (10x FY20E $9.54) | Conservative 2-yr case: +186.1% total (+93.0%/yr) | At 4.5x FY20E the 15% hurdle price $57 sits at or below the BASE case; Net Yields -1.6% in Q1 2020, forward net revenue -16.7% (no FY20 guide in numbers, Q1 2020 revenues); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
